crew.overview: In war-torn colonial America, in the midst of a bloody battle between British, the French and Native American allies, the aristocratic daughter of a British Colonel and her party are captured by a group of Huron warriors. Fortunately, a group of three Mohican trappers comes to their rescue.
crew.title: The Last of the Mohicans

details.biography: Kellie Kyle is best known as the widow of legendary bull rider Lane Frost. She also appeared in the film "8 Seconds" as herself. She married Lane Frost in 1985 and they were together until his death in 1989. She remarried in 1993 to Mike Macy, a rodeo champion with two-time National Finals Rodeo team roping titles.
details.name: Kellie Macy
